<thought>From the 13C NMR data, there are 14 carbon signals. The non‑aromatic signals are the carbonyl at 166 ppm, the aliphatic carbon at 61 ppm, and the methyl carbon at 14 ppm. The remaining 11 signals fall in the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm), indicating 11 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>11</final_answer>
